title: TSX Venture 50
wikitext:
The '''TSX Venture 50''' is a yearly ranking done by the [[TMX Group]] of 50 upcoming companies on the [[TSX Venture Exchange]].

The list is chosen annually by assigning equal weighting assigned to share price appreciation, trading volume, market capitalization growth and analyst coverage.<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.tmx.com/en/news_events/news/news_releases/2011/2-15-2011_TMXGroup-2011Venture50.html |title=TSX Venture Exchange Announces its 2011 TSX Venture 50 |access-date=2011-02-21 |archive-date=2011-07-17 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20110717065120/http://www.tmx.com/en/news_events/news/news_releases/2011/2-15-2011_TMXGroup-2011Venture50.html |url-status=dead }}</ref>
